purpose: Public reviewed-code regression memory; not LLM fine-tuning, a legal fact database, or automatic approval
update_policy: Append source-safe resolved lessons only through reviewed PR with executable tests. Never ingest raw client prompts, credentials, issue-body prose, attachments, or unverified facts.

lessons.failure_mode: Model attempted unsupported article interpretation before removing paragraphs.
lessons.preventive_rule: Missing reviewed article returns deterministic bounded report without model call.
lessons.test_title: Unreviewed Pasal 99 of UU 7/2021 returns a complete source-limited response without a fake article meaning

lessons.failure_mode: Bibliography displayed one legal-index link while count of qualifying article sources was zero.
lessons.preventive_rule: Reference label identifies index metadata and never counts it as verified article text.
lessons.test_title: Source-limited legal export explicitly distinguishes law metadata from a reviewed Pasal source

lessons.failure_mode: Formal law names did not consistently match abbreviated reviewed article anchors.
lessons.preventive_rule: Use canonical statute identifiers before deterministic missing-article fallback.
lessons.test_title: Existing reviewed Pasal is not accidentally withheld when user spells out full law name

lessons.failure_mode: Filtered legal analysis could leave headings without accompanying substantive text.
lessons.preventive_rule: Source-limited report sections remain complete; Word/PDF reference warnings distinguish metadata-only sources.
lessons.test_title: Formal law name source-limited report has substantive text after every heading and never counts index-only metadata
